title: RENAVAM — Registro Nacional de Veículos Automotores

generate.summary: Generates a valid random RENAVAM (Registro Nacional de Veículos Automotores) number.
description: Generates a valid random RENAVAM in the 11-digit form: 10 base digits plus the check digit.

tests.name: generated-is-valid
tests.note: every generated value must pass the lib's own validator

isValid.summary: Validates if a RENAVAM (Registro Nacional de Veículos Automotores) is valid.
description: Validates a RENAVAM: the old format (9 digits, left-padded to 11) or the new format (11 digits), with a modulus 11 check digit.
- Spaces, dots and hyphens are ignored; any other character, a letter in particular, makes the value invalid.
- A value whose digits are all the same is rejected.
